name: Whispers in the Tunnels
description: Beneath Thepyrgos, the tunnels remember what the city above has forgotten. Routine maintenance on ancient Aelerian seals goes catastrophically wrong when the Deep Drake—an ancient psychic entity—stirs in the flooded depths. The PCs are trapped underground as reality warps, whispers multiply, and their own minds become battlegrounds for its freedom. Survive, or become part of its eternal song.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper
